remarks: One of the largest one bedroom corner units in the complex at 934 square feet in up to the minute, move in ready condition! Imagine an English style courtyard entrance with ivy covered brick exterior and port-cochere in this pre war building where charm and character abound. A wonderful east/west exposure floods the unit with natural light all day long and the evening hours give you sparkling city views. A defined entry foyer, 9' ceilings and a long list of recent improvements including all new windows, bathroom renovation, kitchen updates, refinished hardwood floors and more. An easy walk to downtown and CT Transit has a stop practically at your front door. A wonderful city gem.
